transfer.qualification: Twelve outcome-selected discovery cells plus 348 previously measured parent controls. Raw rival actions cannot adapt; guarded rank routes are not recovered private agents. Technical verification does not admit the candidate or estimate a live rating.

fresh.qualification: One frozen combined timing hypothesis against published V221B on twelve prespecified new seeds, both seats, two related intact reacting sources. No prefix or outcome selection. This is family-specific confirmation, not a population rating. Reference frozen while broad transfer is running, before any fresh outcomes.
fresh.prospective_gate: Require no net loss of wins versus B overall or in either opponent family; inspect all newly lost wins and tail deterioration before promotion. A better mean cannot compensate for worse outcomes. Failure rejects C as the default; retuning requires a new hypothesis and new confirmation seeds.

soil.qualification: New completed public histories collected after B was frozen. Original deployed source in actual seat must reproduce both rewards. Counterfactuals use fixed rival actions; this is not a random live win rate.

moon.qualification: New completed public histories collected after B was frozen. Original deployed source in actual seat must reproduce both rewards. Counterfactuals use fixed rival actions; this is not a random live win rate.
